collection: gradient_noise.py at frozen initial toy model; 64 independent with-replacement batches of 16 rows
statistics: raw Float32-autograd gradients, flattened per 12x12 hidden matrix; standard-library variance and corrected signal
verification: global RNG preserved by the collection function
record schema and exclusive file creation
isolated subprocess replay with -I -S and no third-party packages
model_state: The toy has no dropout or mutable running statistics; extending the collector requires matching the intended objective and state.
sampling: Repeated IID outcomes are allowed; copying an existing gradient or replaying a file adds no observations.
interface_issue_fixed: Native #noise-capture on details had top 0 behind the 64px nav. A standard h4 now has 96px scroll margin and native top approximately 96px.

first_probe.scope: fixed synthetic model; raw gradients before momentum or NS; no optimal-LR claim
